recentItems.description:
DISTANT - Flesh and Nails (feat. Kyle Medina) (OFFICIAL VIDEO)
New single “Flesh and Nails (feat. Kyle Medina)” by DISTANT, out now via Century Media Records. Taken from the upcoming album “Into Despair” out November 6th, 2026. Pre-Order now: https://DistantBand.lnk.to/IntoDespair_AlbumID 

Video produced and filmed by Bart Sperling 

Produced: Nouri Yetgin  
Vocals Produced: Alan Grnja, Vojta Pacesny  
Lyrics: Alan Grnja  
Mix & Master: Nouri Yetgin, Roelof Klop 
  
Lyrics: 

In the shadows they weave  
Distinguished wicked arts  
Suffocating whispers tearing my world apart  
They never sleep  
Spitting toxic grace an orchestrated falsehood  
Within this darkest place betrayed by whispers  
Drowning myself in illusion, a bitter defeat  
A serpent's tongue coils a venomous sword that is shattered into pieces  

Cowards die one thousand deaths  
I’ll gut you with the blade you left in my back  
Bleed out of your fuckin’ eyes  
Eardrums ruptured  
Your lungs collapse (your lungs collapse)  
Filling up with fluid  
Drowning in your own filth  

Hopeless delusions  
A psalm of disdain  
Suffocating whispers  
Driving me insane  
Bloodied by trust, a treacherous game, I am left to maim  

I am still torn by your reflection, but my vision still fades    

Dig your own grave and bury yourself just like you did innocence  
And entomb everything you hold dear  
Dig deep  

Dig your own grave  
In the deep you will find your meaning  
I hope you won’t rest easy  
Bitch  

Eat shit
